redistribution_policy: freely redistributable inputs and tools only

phylocsf.rationale: Method-native configuration used for the hg38 whole-genome GENCODE PhyloCSF analysis; retained for calibrated coding-potential inference.

gpn_star_optional.reason_not_default: PhyloCSF already supplies deep vertebrate/mammalian coding evidence; a third GPU model is retained for targeted sensitivity analysis.

decision_rules: Never feed GPN-MSA output into GPN-Star; GPN-Star consumes its own alignment directly.
Never merge scores across phylogenetic timescales into one numeric score.
GPN-Star is a constraint and variant-effect axis, not a coding-potential classifier.
Reference acquisition must verify upstream checksums or content-addressed repository revisions before scoring.
